summary: CS-ENT-CI-GATE-ARCH-ROLE-MATRIX-001 normalizes catalog roles for local runtime reference, harness, and readiness-plan composer crates so the architecture-boundaries role matrix reflects their actual dependency posture. The full architecture-boundaries gate moved from 27 forbidden dependency-edge diagnostics plus 41 package-placement diagnostics to 0 forbidden dependency-edge diagnostics and the same 41 package-placement diagnostics. No code, runtime behavior, package directory placement, storage/listener/Workflow/payment/audit runtime, cloud deployment, or SLO claim is changed.

findings: The slice changes only catalog role metadata and plan/todo/evidence rows; no Rust source or package manifests changed.
The role changes map crates that consume app-layer envelopes or compose runtime/readiness plans to the repo's runtime role instead of pure adapter/test/infrastructure roles.
Architecture-boundaries role-edge diagnostics were reduced from 27 to 0, improving broad CI signal for later cloud integration.
The remaining blocker is explicitly limited to package placement under microservices/*, which requires a separate layout migration or policy change.
A post-change full architecture-boundaries run reports zero forbidden dependency-edge diagnostics.
The gate still fails on 41 package-placement diagnostics, so evidence does not overclaim a full architecture pass.

findings: Future broad-gate triage now sees only package-placement diagnostics instead of mixed placement and role-edge noise.
